title: Affine pushout ring section presentation
statement: The affine pushout ring has a second inclusion section map whose counit is the identity and whose products with the first inclusion additively generate every affine section.

proof.text: Apply the affine pullback section comparison to the restricted-scalar module; transport it through the object identification and κ, then verify the two actions and the unit formula on pure tensors.

theorem affine_pushout_ring_section_presentation [IsAffineHom f]
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
    (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B) (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf)
    (hring : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t ∧ b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf ∧ t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) := (f.app V).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ δ : Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) →+* B.obj.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
      (∀ c, (ε.hom.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom (δ c) = c) ∧
      (∀ r : B.obj.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
        ∃ l : List (Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) × Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
          r = (l.map fun x ↦ (b.hom.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom x.1 * δ x.2).sum)
